J.text: How many lines of symmetry does a (non-square) rectangle have?
steps: A non-square rectangle has one line of symmetry through the midpoints of the long sides, and one through the midpoints of the short sides.
Its diagonals are not lines of symmetry (unlike a square).

steps: Let the numbers be n−2, n, n+2. Sum = 3n = 90, so n = 30.
